_meta._note: Sakana Fugu beta announcement Apr 24 2026. Multi-agent orchestration system that dynamically coordinates a pool of frontier LLMs (Gemini, GPT, Claude). Sakana Fugu itself is a small model that learns to call other LLMs and can recursively call itself for test-time scaling. 2 variants: Fugu Mini (latency-optimized) + Fugu Ultra (full orchestration, performance-optimized). Based on ICLR 2026 papers TRINITY + Conductor. Beta only — API access via OpenAI-format endpoints.
